title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  
Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  
In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  
About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering team is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  
If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. The job is highly variable and requires both the ability to make data-driven decisions, and draw conclusions based on incomplete information. We're looking for out-of-the-box thinkers who can complement and extend the already formidable talents of our Customer Engineering organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and team development
* Submit and manage effective escalations, coach others on how to engage with Engineering and Product teams
* Utilize advanced software skills to configure, troubleshoot, or automate ThousandEyes product workflow
* Drive serviceability, usability, and product improvement efforts through customer feedback and technical insights
* Represent the support function in cross-functional meetings and customer engagements
* Contribute proactively to digital transformation by creating scripts, automation tools, and reusable assets
* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model

Qualifications
  

* A standout"customer firs" attitude
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4-7 + years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer-facing role
* Specialist-level certifications (e.g. CCNP) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles - TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Working knowledge of virtualization technology - containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Working knowledge in security - authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies
* Proficient in automation, programmability, orchestration, virtualization, and/or security
* Reads and applies industry standards, RFCs, and architectural documents
* Mentors team members and drives team goals into actionable initiatives
* Influences product development through trends analysis and cross-functional collaboration
* Regional or global impact; regularly interacts with customers, leadership, and product teams
* Leads original and creative initiatives that are critical to organization success

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

**General Summary:**

Job Title: Engineer BTSW-HOST

Available to New or Recent Graduate: No

Onsite Interview Panel: Rahul Chauhan, Paras Kumar, Girish Sadananda

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* At least 3-6 years’ experience in embedded SW development using the C programming language for Wireless connectivity products

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth host stack.

* Understanding of Bluetooth controller transports and arbitration, including UART, SPI/I3C or comparable inter-processor/controller interfaces.

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Familiarity with Bluetooth SIG qualification, specification interpretation, interoperability events, and contribution to standards or technical working groups.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

* **Educational Requirements:**

Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics or Computer Science from an internationally recognized institution.

  

**Keywords:** C Programming, Bluetooth host Protocols, Bluetooth Profiles, LE Audio (LEA), BT, Sniffer, Air logs

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1+ year of experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* 1+ year of experience with Database Management Software.

* 1+ year of experience with API.

* 1+ year of work experience with Git, Perforce, or Source Code Management System.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Applies Software knowledge to assist and support the design, development, creation, modification, and validation of embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs.

* Analyzes user needs and software requirements.

* Designs and implements small software features for products and systems.

* Participates in the design, coding for small features, unit testing, minor debugging fixes, and integration efforts to ensure projects are completed on schedule.

* Assists in performing code reviews and regression tests as well as the triaging of issues to ensure the quality of code.

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

  

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and transparency.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific.

  
  
  

**Role Description:**

  

This is a great opportunity for a hands-on DevOps Engineers or Infrastructure Cloud Engineers with experience in cloud platforms (GCP). You will be tasked with transforming business requirements into robust cloud infrastructure solutions which forms the underlying foundation for all distributed systems and applications of the LSE Group.

  

As a Cloud Platform Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will support and enhance our cloud environment, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and cost-efficiency. This role involves close collaboration with various teams to drive cloud adoption and implement GCP standard methodologies.

  

**Main Responsibilities:**

  

GCP Infrastructure Design and Implementation:

* Implement scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure using GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, and Interconnect.

* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and YAML configuration files.

  
  

Security and Compliance

* Apply GCP security best practices including IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, and Organization Policies.

  
  

Automation and DevOps Integration

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab pipelines.

* Automate deployments and infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and GitOps practices.

  

Networking and Hybrid Connectivity

* Manage VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules and policies, Cloud NAT, and Private Google Access.

* Implement networking features such as VPC Peering, Shared VPC, VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.

  
  

Agile Practices and Teamwork Tools

* Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives).

* Use Jira for task tracking and Confluence for documentation and teamwork.

  
  

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Stay current with GCP innovations and evaluate new services for potential adoption.

* Propose and implement improvements to enhance performance, security, and developer experience.

  
  

**Required Skills:**

  

Experience

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience with GCP services.

  
  

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of GCP services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Interconnect, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Network Connectivity Center (NCC), Workload Identity Federation (WIF).

* Experience with Terraform and YAML for Infrastructure as Code.

* Networking knowledge: VPC design, VPN, Cloud NAT, Interconnect, Peering, firewall rules and policies.

* Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (GKE).

* Experience with Python for various applications.

* Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

  
  

Certifications

* Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or other relevant GCP certifications.

  
  

Soft Skills

* Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

* Communication and collaboration abilities.

* Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies.

Catalyst Brands is a leading U.S.-based retail organization formed in 2025 through the merger of JCPenney and SPARC Group, combining multiple iconic fashion brands under one umbrella. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Catalyst Brands focuses on delivering modern retail experiences while leveraging the heritage of established global brands. With a workforce of over tens of thousands and multi-billion-dollar revenue, the organization operates at a large scale across retail, e-commerce, and supply chain domains. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies to enhance brand value and consumer engagement. title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* **Define eval taxonomies and rubrics** — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* **Instrument production observability** — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* **Benchmark and select models** — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* **Analyze and interpret evaluation results**, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* **Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies** — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* **Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts** (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* **Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects**, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* **Evaluate new technologies and patterns** (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* **Partner with policy and legal teams** to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* **Provide technical leadership to engineers**, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* **8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience**, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* **2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building**, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* **2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy,** quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* **1+ years** in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

### **Technical Skills**

* **Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation** — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* **Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns** — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* **Production experience with eval pipelines** — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* **Proficiency in Python** — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* **Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service** relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* **Statistical literacy** — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* **Enterprise product sensibility** — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* **Excellent communication** — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows**, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Languages:** Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* **Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright**
* **LLM Providers:** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
* **Eval Tooling:** DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
* **Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries:** LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
* **Infrastructure:**DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge**: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
* **Data Analysis:** Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
* **Policy Background:** Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
* **Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools**: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
* **Experience testing complex APIs,** especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
* **Experience with prompt injection (Must)** and data poisoning skills is a plus
* **Certifications in AI/ML**, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* **Proven ability to lead without direct authority**, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.
* **Experience working in agile environments**, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.
* **Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills**, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
* Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
* Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
* Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
* Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
* Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
* Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing — design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

------------------------------------------------

title: Compiler Performance Engineer
description:
**Falcon** is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a **Compiler Performance Engineer** to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

### **What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**

* Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
* Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
* Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
* Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
* Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

### **What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**

* 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
* Strong C++ design and coding skills
* Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
* Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

### **Very Nice to Have**

* Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
* Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
* Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture
* Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals
* MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus

You will work at the intersection of data engineering, platform engineering, and data governance, enabling analytics and AI teams to build on data they can trace and trust.
  
  
Your Impact
  

* Design, build, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines on Snowflake and/or Databricks
* Turn reference architectures and data contracts from the Principal AI Data Architect into robust, production-grade implementations
* Deliver reliable, observable, cloud-native ETL/ELT for both structured and unstructured data
* Modernize legacy jobs with measurable gains in latency, reliability, and cost

Implement the semantic models, dimensional schemas, and entity-centric structures that make data trustworthy and reusable
  

* Maintain the metadata, catalog, and lineage that let any downstream consumer trace an output back to its source
* Build the low-latency APIs, materialized views, and serving layers that power dashboards, reporting, and ML/AI applications
* Embed data quality checks, RBAC/ABAC, masking, and encryption directly into your pipelines
* Instrument workflows with logs and metrics so failures are caught before consumers see them
* Automate testing, deployment, and rollback through CI/CD — a pipeline isn't"don" until it's tested, observable, and in an automated deployment workflow

**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

5–8 years of hands-on data engineering or software engineering experience building production data platforms
  

* Cloud Data Platforms – Proven experience building and operating cloud-native pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and/or Snowflake, with modern orchestration tooling (Airflow, dbt, Dagster, or equivalent).
* Batch& Streaming Processing – Strong production experience with both batch and streaming data processing (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Kinesis, or equivalent).
* Python, SQL& Data Modeling – Strong Python and SQL, with data modeling depth across dimensional, star/snowflake, and entity-centric patterns, and a track record of performance and cost tuning.
* Data Quality& Observability – Practical experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, and observability for production pipelines.
* Cloud, CI/CD& Containers – Hands-on with AWS and/or Azure services (S3, Glue, Lambda, ADLS, Data Factory, or equivalents), plus CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and containers (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Data Governance – Working knowledge of access control, masking, encryption, lineage, and auditability.

**Nice to have qualifications:**  

* Infrastructure as Code – Practical exposure to Terraform or equivalent IaC tooling for provisioning and managing data infrastructure.
* Search& Vector Platforms – Experience with OpenSearch, pgvector, or similar search and retrieval platforms.
* Knowledge Graphs – Familiarity with graph data stores such as Neo4j and entity-relationship modeling at scale.
* ML& AI Pipeline Exposure – Exposure to embedding pipelines, vector search, MLflow, or ML/LLMOps tooling, and general familiarity with how data pipelines feed model training and inference. Welcome but not required — we'll teach you that side.
* Cloud Cost Awareness – Interest in right-sizing cloud resources and improving the efficiency of automation and data pipelines.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. title: Principal Engineer -Data Engineering
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Principal Engineer to design, architect, and lead Data Engineering initiatives within the HR Information Technology organization. This role requires a hands‑on technologist who can anchor critical initiatives to drive operational excellence and enhance employee and customer experience.

The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership across the design, development, and operationalization of Data and Generative AI solutions, while shaping the enterprise HR data strategy. This role will oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions across the HR data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI‑driven insights, and next‑generation HR capabilities. The Principal Engineer will also act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing architecture decisions, solution design, and implementation strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long‑term technology strategy.

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of progressive engineering experience with sustained hands‑on expertise in architecture, system design, and end‑to‑end solution development.
* 7+ years of Data Engineering experience, with strong expertise in driving migration from legacy data platforms to cloud‑native, lakehouse‑based architectures
* 3+ Years of Hands-on experience in transformation of legacy data framework to modern stack in private or public cloud.
* Architect and implement modern data platforms using Azure Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Synapse, Real‑Time Analytics, Power BI integration).
* Design and build data pipelines and platforms on GCP using services such as : BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Pub/Sub, Dataproc/Spark, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataplex, Data Catalog

* Deep expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Beam)
* Strong hands‑on background of developing large scale enterprise applications.

* Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Hands on experience in building modernized applications using Microservice architecture.
* Cloud-native engineering experience — serverless, managed Spark, event-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, K8s) and workflow operators.
* Knowledge of data governance platforms (Collibra, Alation, Purview).
* Experience implementing lineage, observability, drift detection.

* Drive innovation by introducing emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices to improve decision‑making, automation, and predictive insights.
* Strong background in AI, Machine Learning, GenAI, including retrieval systems, embeddings, chunking strategies, and agentic AI workflows.

**Job Expectations:**

* Enterprise Technical Stewardship
  + Act as a Principal Engineer and strategic advisor to senior leadership, shaping technology decisions that impact multiple lines of business and the broader enterprise.
  + Define and evolve enterprise‑scale architectures for Data modernization ensuring alignment with security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Hands‑On Leadership
  + Remain deeply hands‑on—designing, reviewing, and occasionally coding critical components to set a high engineering bar.
  + Lead by example in applying engineering rigor, automation, testing, performance optimization, and secure coding practices.
* Influence & Thought Leadership
  + Serve as a visible technical spokesperson internally and externally, presenting ideas, architectures, and innovation narratives with clarity and conviction.
  + Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising the overall technical maturity of the organization.
  + Foster a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity, and continuous learning.
* Outside‑In Innovation
  + Continuously scan the external ecosystem to bring new ideas, technologies, and patterns into the enterprise in a pragmatic, value‑driven manner.
  + Challenge legacy thinking and advocate for simplification, modernization, and platform thinking.

As an Application Engineer Salesforce at YouTube, you will be a part of the salesforce-focused engineering team building business systems for the YouTube GTMS T&I Partnership Systems team that is tasked with achieving greater creator satisfaction and success.  
  
Your work enables our partnership teams to provide strategic, outcomes-focused insights for our top YouTube creators. Outcomes of the team keep the YouTube business organization nimble, able to understand partner needs and innovate accordingly.  
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. description:
### **Job Title**

R&D Service Engineer

### **Job Description**

**R&D Service Engineer**

Join our global Level 3 (L3) Technical Support organization and serve as a key database expert, helping resolve complex, business-critical issues in large-scale healthcare production environments.

**Your role:**

* Provide advanced Oracle database support for critical customer escalations and complex production incidents, acting as the highest level of database expertise within Support.
* Troubleshoot database performance, availability, and configuration issues using tools such as Automatic Workload Repository (AWR), Active Session History (ASH), SQL traces, execution plans, and database performance statistics.
* Lead deep root cause analysis for recurring and high-impact database incidents, partnering closely with Research & Development (R&D), Product, infrastructure, and engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Support major customer activities including upgrades, migrations, failovers, go-lives, and other business-critical events while participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation.
* Contribute to long-term support excellence by developing troubleshooting tools, documenting best practices, and mentoring other L3 engineers.

**You’re the right fit if:**

* You’ve acquired strong 7-10 yrs hands-on experience with Oracle Enterprise Database: Oracle 19c and older Oracle versions
* Your skills include SQL and PL/SQL development, database performance tuning, and advanced troubleshooting using AWR, ASH, SQL Trace, execution plans, and Oracle dynamic performance views.
* You have a strong understanding of database architecture, including sessions, locking, memory management, storage, connectivity, and performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure on which Oracle is installed and relying: Storage, Networking, Virtualization, Operating Systems
* You’re an analytical problem solver with experience handling critical production incidents, customer escalations, and cross-functional investigations spanning database, application, operating system, storage, and network layers.
* You’re comfortable working independently, making technical decisions under pressure, collaborating across global teams, and participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation.
Preferred: Experience with Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Data Guard, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, Windows Server environments, healthcare applications, high-availability infrastructure, or automation using PowerShell, SQL, or Python  

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Introduction:

**About SymphonyAI**  
SymphonyAI Industrial is a global leader in Industrial AI, enabling manufacturers and asset-intensive enterprises to transform fragmented IT, OT, and edge data into real-time, contextual intelligence that improves uptime, throughput, and operational efficiency.

Job Description:

**About the Role**

Build technical depth while providing dependable customer support across SymphonyAI Industrial products. This is the foundational engineering level, focused on disciplined triage, clear customer communication, accurate documentation, and resolution of common issues with guidance from more experienced engineers.

This role participates in both Level 1 (L1) and Level 2 (L2) support activities based on business need, skill, access, and incident priority. The role also participates in the 24/7 on-call rotation and responds to assigned incidents within applicable service-level targets and escalation procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Customer Support and Incident Management**
--------------------------------------------

* Receive, clarify, categorize, and troubleshoot customer requests through approved support channels.
* Perform L1 triage and resolve common L1 and L2 issues using documented procedures, known solutions, and guidance from senior engineers.
* Collect complete diagnostic information, reproduce issues when feasible, and escalate with a clear problem statement, evidence, customer impact, and actions already attempted.
* Maintain accurate ticket status, customer communications, time entries, resolution details, and handoff notes.

**Technical Investigation**
---------------------------

* Use foundational skills in SQL, Windows/Linux, application logs, networking concepts, and cloud services to investigate incidents.
* Execute approved diagnostic queries, scripts, and operational procedures without introducing avoidable risk.
* Support root cause analysis by gathering evidence, documenting observations, and validating corrective actions.

**Knowledge and Collaboration**
-------------------------------

* Create and update knowledge articles, troubleshooting notes, and customer-specific support documentation.
* Participate in team meetings, technical deep dives, shift handoffs, and product knowledge sessions.
* Support project transitions and hypercare activities by validating support readiness and reporting issues promptly.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years of technical support, system administration, software operations, or comparable experience, including internships or equivalent practical experience.
* Working familiarity with SQL, one or more scripting or programming languages, Windows or Linux, and basic cloud concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication, careful documentation habits, and willingness to ask for guidance.
* Ability to prioritize work, follow change and escalation controls, and learn multiple products and customer environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Exposure to Azure or AWS, Kubernetes or Docker, application performance monitoring, and ticketing platforms such as Azure DevOps, Zendesk, Jira, or ServiceNow.
* Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA, or ITIL Foundation certification.
* Interest in industrial software, manufacturing, IoT, or operational technology.

**Role Success and Growth**
===========================

* Progress is demonstrated through reliable ticket ownership, accurate diagnosis, complete documentation, safe execution, and increasing independence.
* Development path may include Technical Support Engineer 2, product specialization, project support, or other technical roles.

About Us:

SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1500+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 3,000 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

Lakehouse, enterprise data modeling, data domains, data products, data contracts, integration patterns, reference architecture, metadata and governance

Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Delta Lake, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data quality, lineage and observability.

LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector/semantic search, NLP, knowledge graphs, responsible AI and AI-enabled workflows.

AWS, CI/CD, Git, automated testing and scalable cloud data processing

SIEM/SOAR, security telemetry, vulnerability, identity, incident and threat intelligence data.

Power BI, semantic models, operational metrics and executive reporting.

===========================

* This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration expectations.

* The role will require sound judgment when working with sensitive cybersecurity, risk, operational, and regulated data.

* The candidate should be comfortable balancing exploratory data science, production-minded analytical delivery, and stakeholder communication.

**Why this role is important to us**

**Cybersecurity increasingly depends on the ability to engineer, integrate, analyze, and intelligently interpret large volumes of complex security data. title: Data & AI Architect
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Data & AI Architect to define and govern the target architecture for Advanced Analytics, AI, and Data Products across SVD TEC. As the Data & AI Architect, you will ensure that analytics and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, secure, reusable, and governed foundation rather than isolated project-specific solutions.

You will define architecture standards, integration patterns, data contracts, AI deployment approaches, and governance models that enable teams to consistently deliver analytics and AI capabilities across products such as EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, condition monitoring, and predictive maintenance. You will act as the technical authority connecting business needs, product strategy, data platforms, AI services, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and product teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the target Data & AI Architecture for SVD TEC.
* Establish standards for data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, AI, and interoperability.
* Design reusable architecture building blocks and reference patterns.
* Define architecture principles for Data Products, Data Governance, Data Quality, Analytics Platforms, MLOps, AI Platforms, Agent Architectures, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Integration Services.
* Drive architectural alignment across SDA, EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, and future initiatives.
* Define integration approaches between internal platforms, customer environments, industrial systems, cloud services, and AI capabilities.
* Establish data contracts, API standards, interoperability guidelines, and reusable integration patterns.
* Participate in technology evaluations and partner assessments.
* Review and approve architectural decisions for major AI and analytics initiatives.
* Support cybersecurity, compliance, and governance reviews.
* Define transition strategies from PoC to MVP to production.
* Coach engineers and project teams on architecture best practices.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and architectural debt early.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

* Strong experience as Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, Data Architect, Analytics Architect, or AI Architect.
* Deep understanding of modern data architectures and analytics platforms.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of Data Lakehouse architectures, Data Warehousing, Data Mesh, Data Products, Data Governance, Metadata, Data Catalogs, Event-driven architectures, API architectures, and Cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with AI deployment architectures, MLOps, and operationalization of models.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience balancing long-term architecture goals with delivery realities.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills & Attributes:**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Foundry, Fabric, Cognite Data Fusion, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial data platforms, time-series data, asset models, historian systems, and IoT architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Layers, GraphRAG, Agentic AI Architectures, Multi-Agent Systems, Vector Databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, identity management, confidential data handling, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent systems thinking and ability to identify architectural dependencies across products and teams.
* Pragmatic mindset that prioritizes business value while maintaining architectural integrity.

**About the Team:**

Join the Advanced Analytics team responsible for establishing the long-term Data & AI foundation across SVD TEC. This role will shape how analytics, AI, digital products, and industrial data platforms evolve over the coming years. You will ensure that innovations in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, AI assistants, analytics products, and agentic AI are built on a common architecture that is scalable, maintainable, secure, and reusable across the portfolio.

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e\-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.


We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  

Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self\-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.


We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  

From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.


Working at Myntra is challenging but fun \- we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

The CPE team builds and maintains centralized and high\-scale platforms for sophisticated application security frameworks, log collection, monitoring systems, access management, secret management, database access, change management systems, build, release and deployment. Purpose of the Job \- The Data \& Analytics Data Engineer plays a pivotal role in advancing the organization's data strategy and delivering robust analytical solutions across critical business functions. This position is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. Working within a cross\-functional team, the Data Engineer will identify analytical opportunities, contribute to solution architecture, and ensure the secure and compliant handling of confidential data.  

Responsibilities:  

Retrieve, integrate, and prepare diverse datasets for analysis by the Data \& Analytics team and the broader business user community.  

Collaborate as a key technical interface with local IT landscape teams and various business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions.  

  

Key Responsibilities: The Data \& Analytics Data Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robust data products and solutions within a Microsoft Azure\-based data ecosystem. This role involves:  

Data Product Development: Leading the retrieval, migration, integration, and construction of data products, applying industry\-proven disciplines in Data Acquisition, Integration, Curation, and Distributed Data Processing to support diverse Data \& Analytics use cases.  

Pipeline Architecture \& Automation: Designing, deploying, and automating scalable data pipelines in an Azure Databricks\-based Lakehouse, leveraging Azure Data Factory and Databricks best practices. This includes transforming and curating datasets for rapid consumption and discovery by analytical and business users.  

Data Modernization: Contributing to the migration of complex on\-premise data solutions to Azure, ensuring efficiency and scalability.  

Technical Leadership: Providing technical expertise and mentoring to foster best practices within the data engineering space and coordinating development and support activities.  

  

Required Skills \& Experience:  

Azure Data Platform Expertise:  

Solid experience in building modular, extensible, and highly resilient ETL/ELT data pipelines using Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, and Azure Integration Runtime.  

Proven ability to enable and support BI/reporting application development using Microsoft Power BI.  

Solid experience with Microsoft Azure\-based Enterprise Data Warehouse implementations, including DWH/Datamart design, development, and Data Engineering for supporting enterprise\-scale BI/Reporting applications.  

In\-depth knowledge of the Azure data ecosystem, including Azure SQL Data Warehouse (Synapse), MS SQL Server, and advanced Databricks features (Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), as well as connectivity solutions like Express Route.  

Data Migration \& Modernization:  

Solid experience migrating on\-premise data pipelines built using technologies like Informatica to Azure Data Factory/Databricks.  

Knowledge of migrating large, complex on\-premise Data Warehouses (e.g., IBM DB2 LUW, z/OS) to MS Azure\-based data warehouses/lakehouses.  

DevOps \& Automation:  

Extensive experience with data pipeline automation, orchestration, and administration using a comprehensive DevOps toolchain (e.g., Artifactory, GitHub, Confluence, Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).  

Proficiency in supporting large, complex daily batch ingestion processes with a strong emphasis on Delta processing techniques.  

Data Governance \& Quality:  

Knowledge of Data Modeling principles and Metadata Management techniques (e.g., data lineage) using tools like Databricks, Sybase Power Designer, or Alation Data Catalog.  

Work directly with Data \& Analytics, IT, Global Cloud Solutions teams, Source Systems as well as representatives from vendors to identify and resolve issues and remove obstacles in achieving the Data \& analytics goals.  

Expertise in designing and building efficient data pipelines and workflows to support custom workloads while ensuring data quality using Microsoft Azure technologies (Data Factory, ADLS, Databricks, Integration Runtime, ExpressRoute, Power BI, DevOps, MLflow, Artifactory, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, Synapse).  

Strong experience in assembling and managing large, complex datasets to meet the functional requirements of Data Warehouse and BI applications.  

Skilled in transforming raw and disparate data into structured, clean, and accessible datasets for Business Intelligence and analytics applications.  

Proficient in automating data processing workflows and pipelines using CA Autosys R11, Python, shell scripting, and Azure DevOps CI/CD processes, with experience integrating data products through APIs using JSON/XML.  

Experience working in distributed cluster environments with Unix/Linux command\-line interfaces and Bash scripting.  

  

Query, retrieve, integrate, and prepare data to support profiling, analysis, and the development of BI and reporting applications.  

Analyze and profile datasets to identify sensitive fields and assist in defining rules for data anonymization and tokenization.  

Generate descriptive statistics (e.g., min, max, count, sum), identify data types and field lengths, and detect recurring patterns while tagging data with relevant keywords, descriptions, or categories.  

Perform data quality assessments, evaluate join feasibility and risks, and discover and validate metadata.  

Analyze data distributions, identify potential keys and functional dependencies, detect embedded value dependencies, and conduct inter\-table relationship analysis.  

  

Prepare datasets optimized for consumption by data visualization tools such as Power BI.  

Integrate Data Warehouse/Lakehouse pipelines and workflows with visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI) to deliver multiple data streams and enable rich business insights.  

Administer and monitor Data Lake/Lakehouse environments supporting batch and near real\-time data processing.  

Establish connectivity and data interfaces between Azure platforms and diverse source systems, including application databases, data warehouses, data marts, and other analytics systems.  

5\+ Years experience designing and building data pipelines in Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Databricks (Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity catalog), ADLS, Integration Runtime, Express route \& MS SQL Server) supporting Datawarehouses.  

Proficient in creating data pipelines and in hybrid data movement from on\-prem systems to MS Azure.  

Experience with object\-oriented programing languages such as Python, R, Scala, and Java.  

Experience using wide variety of file formats and compression techniques.  

Experience with CI/CD processes.  

Knowledge of emerging Data Engineering tools \& technologies.  

Broad understanding and experience with BI and real time analytics platforms.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


**About the Role**


We're looking for a Platform Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, operability, and evolution of our internal engineering platform. This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of platform engineering, reliability, and intelligent automation with a clear mandate: reduce toil, improve observability, and enable systems (AI agents) to safely operate at scale.


You'll work directly with engineering teams to harden services, respond to incidents, and build automation that makes the platform increasingly self\-managing over time. A key aspect of this role is designing and operating AI\-driven and agent\-based workflows, including the guardrails, validation systems, and observability needed to allow automated systems to safely generate and act on changes in production environments.


**What You'll Do**


* Own reliability, availability, and performance of the internal platform and critical services
* Participate in on\-call rotations; lead incident triage, debugging, root cause analysis, and post\-mortems
* Build and operate platform automation and AI\-powered workflows (including agent\-based systems) to reduce manual operational effort
* Design and implement guardrails, validation pipelines, and safety mechanisms for automated and AI\-generated changes to code and infrastructure
* Enable closed\-loop automation systems (detect diagnose remediate validate) to improve system resilience
* Define and track SLIs and SLOs; use reliability data to guide engineering decisions
* Standardize build, deployment, and release workflows for safe, predictable delivery, including automation\-friendly and AI\-integrated pipelines
* Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities across systems and services, including risks introduced by automated changes
* Partner with development teams on service design, resilience, and operability, with an emphasis on automation\-first and AI\-compatible system design

**Required Qualifications**


* 6\+ years of experience operating production platforms or large\-scale distributed systems
* Proven track record in incident management, on\-call operations, and production debugging
* Strong programming skills in Java, Python, Go, Shell, or equivalent
* Hands\-on experience with observability tooling (monitoring, alerting, logging, tracing)
* Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines and release processes
* Familiarity with platform upgrades, dependency management, and system lifecycle operations
* Experience building or integrating AI\-driven (agent\-based) automation frameworks, or strong interest in this space
* Working knowledge of Linux\-based production environments
* Strong communication and cross\-team collaboration skills

**Nice to Have**


* Experience with SRE frameworks: SLOs, error budgets, reliability reviews
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing
* Background in building self\-healing systems
* History of driving platform standardization across large engineering organizations

**What Success Looks Like at 6 Months**


* Platform reliability metrics are tracked, visible, and trending in the right direction
* On\-call burden is measurably reduced through automation and better runbooks
* At least one significant automation or autonomous remediation initiative shipped and adopted by engineering teams
* Platform upgrades and rollouts are executed safely with documented processes
* AI\-driven or automated changes are safely deployed with clear guardrails, observability, and rollback mechanism

**Key Traits**


Strong ownership mentality. Calm under pressure. Bias toward automation. Systems thinker who doesn't just fix problems but builds systems that prevent, detect, and autonomously remediate issues over time.

title: Lead I - Software Testing
description:
**Role description**  

Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Validation Engineer with expertise in pharmaceutical Serialization and Track \& Trace solutions, preferably the TraceLink platform, and at least 5 years of Computer System Validation (CSV) experience in the pharmaceutical or life\-sciences industry. The role requires practical knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP computerized\-system validation, and data integrity. The successful candidate should understand serialization processes, partner onboarding, system integrations, serial number management, EPCIS data exchange, regulatory reporting, and global Track \& Trace requirements. Key Responsibilities · Plan, author, review, and execute CSV activities for GxP\-regulated serialization and Track \& Trace systems. · Perform validation activities for TraceLink or equivalent serialization applications, interfaces, and related integrations. · Develop, review, and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including the following: · Validation Plans · User Requirements Specifications (URS) · Functional and Design Specifications · GxP and system risk assessments · Installation Qualification, Operational Qualification, and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) protocols · Test scripts and objective test evidence. · Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM) · Validation Summary Reports · Execute functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end validation testing for serialization systems and interfaces. · Validate serialization processes including serial number management, commissioning, aggregation, EPCIS data exchange, partner onboarding, regulatory reporting, and exception handling. · Apply risk\-based validation and maintain traceability among requirements, risks, test cases, defects, and validation evidence. · Document and investigate validation deviations, test failures, defects, and discrepancies, and support their timely resolution. · Support system changes, upgrades, patches, enhancements, and integrations through established change\-control and validation processes. · Maintain validation documentation in an inspection\-ready state and support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections. · Ensure compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP, data\-integrity requirements, and electronic\-record/electronic\-signature controls. Serialization and TraceLink Competencies · Platform experience: Hands\-on experience with pharmaceutical serialization solutions; TraceLink experience is strongly preferred. · Partner onboarding: Experience supporting onboarding and end\-to\-end testing across serialization networks and external partners. · Integration landscape: Experience validating data exchange between enterprise serialization platforms, packaging sites, 3PLs, CMOs or contract manufacturers, Marketing Authorization Holders (MAHs), and other supply\-chain partners. · Serial number management: Knowledge of serial number provisioning to packaging lines, pools and ranges, and CMO/MAH\-related processes. · Serialization events: Understanding of commissioning, decommissioning, aggregation, disaggregation, packing, unpacking, shipping, receiving, and related events. · EPCIS and troubleshooting: Ability to investigate interface failures, transaction errors, EPCIS issues, and data discrepancies. · Global requirements: Working knowledge of pharmaceutical serialization requirements across markets such as the United States, European Union, China, and Canada. Mandatory Qualifications · Five years of relevant CSV experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated life\-sciences industry. · Hands\-on experience with serialization or Track \& Trace systems, with TraceLink exposure. · Strong practical knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP computerized\-system lifecycle management, and data integrity. · Experience creating, reviewing, and executing validation documentation and risk\-based test protocols. · Experience with requirements traceability, test evidence, validation deviations, defects, and change controls. · Strong documentation, analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder\-communication skills. Preferred Serialization Experience · Experience with Serialization / Track \& Trace systems. · Hands\-on TraceLink configuration, validation, partner onboarding, or end\-to\-end integration testing. · Experience with SAP ICH/ASN processes, EPCIS transactions, and message analysis. · Knowledge of GS1 serialization standards and packaging\-line integration. · Experience with global serialization regulatory reporting. · Experience supporting serialization or Track \& Trace implementations, upgrades, migrations, or enhancements. Tools, Processes, and Collaboration · Experience using ServiceNow for RITMs or service requests, incident management, and change requests or change control. · Experience supporting deviations, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), change controls, and production issues in a regulated environment. · Ability to collaborate effectively with Quality, IT, Packaging, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Automation, and external partners.

 **Skills**  

TraceLink, SAP, EPCIS, ServiceNow

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility \& high\-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi\-tiered, low\-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning\-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non\-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.  

  

The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop full\-stack solutions for Post Add to Cart and Cart services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi\-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data\-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

  

A day in the life  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full\-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning\-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long\-term health.  

  

About the team  

We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information.
